g.text: Directional limits allow exceptional complex fibers
Examples A and C: exact fibers of log|sin z₁|; exact envelopes of log|sin z| + log|cos z|
Each red point represents the whole complex z₂ fiber.
Equal Euclidean coordinate scales; direction y=(0,1).
